setup: Sit tall, chest up, arms straight
execution: Pull your elbows down to your sides
Let it rise slowly to straight arms
faults: Don't lean far back to row it down
Don't swing or jerk the bar
Don't let the stack yank you up

notes: Keep the bar in front of the face; don't pull it behind the neck.
Return the bar under control so the stack doesn't slam.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move
